items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And he was on staff with Artie Shaw -- he wrote a lot of those things, until '37.

ctx.x: And he was on staff with Artie Shaw -- he wrote a lot of those things, until '37.

You see, drumnistically, I was forming in my mind the routines that we were playing, but I still had Jo Jones instilled in the back of my mind and the Basie band, and that's the kind of music I like, along with my records of Duke Ellington.
